name: rag
title: Answer questions from a document set

origin.source: Consolidated from the LangGraph RAG and Burr conversational-RAG demos

comparison.purpose: Looks up relevant passages in a small corpus of state-machine docs, rewrites the query and retries once when the first lookup misses, answers only from what it found, and remembers the conversation across turns.

input.question: Why does my app get stuck on the wrong screen?
What is context in a state machine, and how is it updated?

starters.label: What invoking an actor does (hits the corpus)

input.question: What does invoking an actor do when a state is entered or exited?
How do guards keep illegal transitions out of a machine?

starters.label: Off-corpus question (even a rewrite finds nothing)

input.question: How should I shard a Postgres database?
